descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
We are looking for an experienced Senior Java Developer to join our development team and contribute to the design, development, and implementation of scalable, high-performance software solutions.
 The ideal candidate has strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, and modern software development practices. You will work on complex applications, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to technical decisions and architectural improvements.
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java.
Build and maintain microservices-based architectures and distributed systems.
Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services.
Work with Spring Boot and other Java frameworks to deliver robust software solutions.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following software engineering best practices.
Design and implement database solutions and optimize SQL queries.
Collaborate with architects, frontend developers, QA engineers, and business stakeholders.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical and architectural decisions.
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues.
Develop automated tests and ensure high code quality.
Contribute to CI/CD processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Requirements 
5+ years of professional experience in Java development.
Strong knowledge of Java (Java 11 or newer).
Solid experience with Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and Spring Data.
Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
Good knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL.
Experience with ORM frameworks such as Hibernate or JPA.
Knowledge of messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Experience with Git and CI/CD tools.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
Understanding of software design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean code practices.
Experience with unit testing and integration testing (JUnit, Mockito).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Good command of English.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Knowledge of frontend technologies such as Angular or React.
Experience with event-driven architecture.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK.
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
German language skills are an advantage.
